title: SimSandbox model file
description: Format version 1. See docs/decisions/0007-json-model-files.md and docs/decisions/0012-controls-in-model-files.md and docs/decisions/0013-run-section.md and docs/decisions/0023-automatic-fusion.md and docs/decisions/0028-sweeps-as-samples.md.

sample.description: Where a model with no states is evaluated (ADR 0027, ADR 0028); without it such a model is swept over its first parameter. Each sample is recorded with the swept parameters as signals; a grid over two parameters also offers every signal as a grid named 'grid.<signal>'. At most 250000 samples. Invalid values are load errors.

design.description: grid: every combination of evenly spaced values; list: the points in 'values'; random: independent uniform values; latin_hypercube: one value in each of 'count' slices of every parameter; sobol: the first 'count' points of the Sobol sequence (at most 10 parameters).

params.description: The swept parameters. Range defaults to the slider's range, then the suggested range; points (grid only) to 400 for one parameter and 100 each for several.

count.description: random, latin_hypercube and sobol: how many samples.

seed.description: random and latin_hypercube: the generator's seed.

values.description: list: the samples, one value per parameter each.

fusion.description: auto: connected continuous equation blocks with identical methods are solved together as one system; off: only 'groups' are (ADR 0023).

groups.description: Blocks solved together as one system with the given method, overriding their own (ADR 0023).

run.description: Settings that affect results (ADR 0013). Invalid values are load errors.

t_end.description: Where batch runs stop and where the app pauses.

seed.description: The seed every random draw derives from (ADR 0034): the same file and seed give the same run.

type.description: Registered block type, namespaced by domain, e.g. 'eq.lorenz'.

method.description: Method name plus numeric options, e.g. {"name": "rk4", "substeps": 4}.

equations.description: Equations of an 'eq.equations' block, one per line: 'dx/dt = ...' (or "x' = ...") for a state, 'name = ...' for a defined quantity (ADR 0017).

params.description: Values in each parameter's declared unit; omitted parameters take their defaults.

controls.description: How the model is meant to be explored. Never affects results; invalid entries are ignored with a warning.

filters.description: Filters turning recorded data into new signals and fields (ADR 0030, ADR 0032). Each names its inputs; order carries no meaning.

expr.description: expression: over recorded signals, other expressions, parameters ('block.param') and 't'.

mode.description: cut (ADR 0031): along x at fixed y values, along y at fixed x values, or free lines.

at.description: cut along x or y: the fixed values, one per cut.

lines.description: cut along free lines: end points [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]] per cut.

whole.description: cut: the whole field (along x or y) or lines extended to the grid's edges (free).

signals.description: Derived signals as written before filters: name to expression. Still read; converted into expression filters (ADR 0030).

sweep.description: The sweep as written before 'sample': one parameter or a list of two. Still read, leniently, and converted into a grid 'sample' (ADR 0027); views bound to 't' are bound to the first parameter, and two-parameter heat maps and cuts to the 'grid.' signals.

views.description: Views the model opens with; the app shows the first (ADR 0015).

type.description: Registered view type, e.g. 'plot.xy', 'plot.3d' ('plot.time' and 'plot.phase' are read and converted to 'plot.xy', ADR 0018).

bind.description: Slot name to signal: 't', 'block.port' (scalar) or 'block.port[i]'; a list for slots that take several.

view.description: Deprecated single view (ADR 0014); read and converted into 'views', never written.

items.description: 'block.port' for a scalar output, 'block.port[i]' for a vector element.

axes.description: Two axes for 'phase', three for '3d', none for 'time'.
